entry.name: frameaverage~
entry.digest: Perform a piece-wise running averaging of consecutive frames of audio.
entry.description: The frameaverage~ object performs a piece-wise running averaging of consecutive frames of audio. Where the framesmooth~ object can be seen as smoothing in the frequency domain (when using FFT as input), the frameaverage~ object can be seen as performing temporal smoothing, more analogous to the vectral~ object.
